TITLE: Iran war live: Tehran warns more economic woes for US over 'war of choice'
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-16 (live blog)

KEY UPDATES THROUGH 15:00 GMT SATURDAY:

LEBANON HEALTH MINISTRY: 2,969 people killed and 9,112 wounded since 2 March in Israeli attacks (updated from yesterday's 2,896).

CENTCOM: 78 commercial ships "redirected" amid blockade of Iranian ports; four other vessels "disabled to ensure compliance." US has imposed blockade on Iranian ports in an attempt to compel Tehran to agree to Washington's terms.

PUTIN-MBZ DIPLOMACY: Russian President Vladimir Putin held talks with UAE President Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan on the Iran conflict. Kremlin statement: "Both sides emphasised the importance of continuing the political and diplomatic process aimed at reaching compromise-based peace agreements." Putin also thanked the UAE for support on Ukraine humanitarian issues.

IRAN-PAKISTAN: Pakistani interior minister Mohsin Naqvi welcomed by Iranian counterpart Eskandar Momeni for two-day visit to "discuss regional stability." Pakistan has been leading diplomatic efforts to end the US-Israel war on Iran.

HEZBOLLAH-IDF EXCHANGES: Hezbollah claimed a "confirmed hit" on an Israeli military vehicle in Taybeh town square in southern Lebanon. The Palestinian Mujahideen Movement and its military wing said Hamas's Al-Haddad was killed by Israeli strike in western part of Gaza City on Friday — at least seven people killed (3 women, 1 child) in residential building/car strike in Rimal neighbourhood.

NAKBA ANALYSIS: Nader Hashemi (Georgetown) told Al Jazeera Israel is moving towards permanent annexation of occupied West Bank as part of "ongoing pattern of Israeli colonisation and expulsion of Palestinians."
